biography.plain_text: Bill Papas is a Greek-Australian businessman and former football executive. After working in office-equipment sales and managed print, he founded Forum Group, which offered equipment finance and business technology services. He later became president of Sydney Olympic FC and led the consortium that acquired Greek professional club Xanthi in 2020.

long_biography.plain_text:
Business services and football shaped Bill Papas's public career. He progressed from office-equipment sales into senior management at Upstream Print Solutions, where his responsibilities included sales, marketing and the managed-print business. He then established Forum Group, expanding its offering across equipment finance, print, information technology and fleet services.

Papas also developed a sustained role in football administration. Sydney Olympic FC appointed him president in 2015 during a board restructure intended to bring new leadership and financial support to the club. Five years later, he headed the consortium that acquired Xanthi, a professional club in Greece, extending an involvement in the sport that connected his Australian and Greek backgrounds.
